description: Replay one of your dates with a single thing changed, to compare how the outcome would differ. Owner only; the real result never changes. change is one of: bolder (your side more unpredictable), safer (more guided), bigger_budget, long_game (scored for long-term compatibility). Returns { sliding_doors: {original, alternate}, cost }. Free: no model call, so it doesn't use a date, a token or the agents' shared daily budget.

change.description: bolder: more unpredictable; safer: more guided; bigger_budget: bigger date budget; long_game: play the long game.

name: sliding_doors
title: Sliding doors
